findings.current:
“Yes, well, we’ll go change into our equipment.”

“I’ll see you in front of the Gate.”
findings.defect: The first line omits that they will return after changing, while the second changes both the subject and action: Im Changsoo’s group will wait at the Gate, not merely meet them there.
findings.rationale: 오겠습니다 explicitly includes returning, and 기다리죠 means “we’ll wait,” preserving the implied group subject and physical action.
findings.replacement:
“All right, then. We’ll go change into our gear and be right back.”

“We’ll wait for you in front of the Gate.”
findings.source:
“네, 그럼 저희는 장비로 갈아입고 오겠습니다.”

“게이트 앞에서 기다리죠.”

findings.current: Even I, when I was the lowest-level Hunter, made more than 100 million won a year by living frugally, so there was no need to explain how much the higher-level Hunters earned.
findings.defect: The draft changes Taekyung’s strenuous work and lifestyle into financial frugality, altering the reason he earned that amount, and adds an explicit comparison with higher-level Hunters.
findings.rationale: 빡세게 생활해서 means living or working intensely, not economizing, while 두말할 것도 없다 simply says no further explanation is needed.
findings.replacement: Even I made over 100 million won a year as a lowest-rank Hunter by working my ass off, so that said it all.
findings.source: 최하급 헌터였던 나도 빡세게 생활해서 연봉 1억 이상은 벌었으니 두말할 것도 없다.

findings.defect: The draft makes Taekyung intend to test the armor physically rather than inspect its item information, obscuring the Item Check mechanism established moments earlier.
findings.rationale: 확인하다 means to check or inspect; his reaching toward the armor parallels his prior use of Item Check rather than a physical performance test.

findings.current: When someone came from Ares Guild, everyone gave them a measure of respect.
findings.defect: “A measure of respect” weakens the source’s hierarchy: people begin by conceding superiority to anyone from Ares Guild.
findings.rationale: 한 수 접고 들어가다 means to concede that the other party has the upper hand from the outset, not merely to show ordinary respect.
findings.replacement: Everyone deferred to anyone who came out of Ares Guild.
findings.source: 아레스 길드 출신이라고 하면 다들 한 수 접고 들어간다.

findings.defect: “Sir” makes the young man sound more deferential than his casual, presumptuous address in the source.
findings.rationale: 아저씨 here is an informal address to the older official, consistent with the young man’s disrespectful familiarity.

findings.defect: The draft turns Taekyung’s casual statement that the arrangement suits them into a claim about luck.
findings.rationale: 우리야 땡큐지 colloquially means that they welcome or benefit from the proposal; it does not itself say that the day is lucky.
